description.value: Statue of Liberty / Ellis Island tour candidate uses Statue City Cruises, the ONLY ferry service that brings visitors to Liberty and Ellis Islands, with departures from Castle Clinton in Battery Park. All ferry tickets include access to the Statue of Liberty Museum and the Ellis Island National Museum of Immigration. Crown tickets allow visitors to access the crown of the statue, which includes a walk up 162 steps from the feet of the statue to the crown. To visit both islands in one day, the National Park Service recommends an early ferry departure. Wait time can be an hour or more during peak times, including summer, weekends, and holidays. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “the boat ride was calm, and the views were amazing”. Representative watch-outs: “had to wait in the heat for nearly an hour for a boat”.
